events.long: Родился в Филадельфии, штат Пенсильвания, вторым по старшинству ребёнком в семье застройщика и домохозяйки.

evidence.quote: until he went to the Fort Lauderdale News and Sun-Sentinel in 1981. There, he covered the crime beat during the South Florida cocaine wars.

evidence.quote: his wife, Linda McCaleb, whom he had met while in college and married in April 1984

events.short: Финалист Пулитцера за репортаж о катастрофе

evidence.quote: in 1986 he and two other reporters spent several months interviewing survivors of the 1985 Delta Flight 191 plane crash, which story earned Connelly a place as a finalist for the Pulitzer Prize

events.short: Переезд в Лос-Анджелес, Los Angeles Times

evidence.quote: He moved to California in 1987 with his wife, Linda McCaleb

evidence.quote: Connelly received a good deal of publicity in 1994 when President Bill Clinton came out of a bookstore carrying a copy of The Concrete Blonde
